Extract multiple Open Graph tags including type, url, and site_name

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><meta property="og:title" content="Article Title"><meta property="og:type" content="article"><meta property="og:url" content="https://example.com/article"><meta property="og:site_name" content="Example Site"><meta property="og:description" content="An interesting article."><meta property="og:image" content="https://example.com/article.jpg"></head><body><article><p>Article content here.</p></article></body></html>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
